description: This file defines the UUID class within the Thunder::Bluetooth namespace, providing functionality for handling Bluetooth UUIDs including creation, comparison, conversion to string, and parsing from string.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: A class representing a Bluetooth UUID, supporting various constructors, comparison operators, and string conversion methods.

methods.name: UUID()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing UUID to invalid state.

methods.name: UUID(const uint32_t uuid)
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a 32-bit integer, setting the internal representation accordingly.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const uint8_t uuid[16])
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a 16-byte array, determining if it contains a short UUID or full UUID.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a string representation, parsing the string to initialize the UUID.

methods.name: UUID(const UUID& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: ~UUID()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying UUID.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the UUID is valid.

methods.name: Short()
methods.description: Returns the 16-bit short UUID if available.

methods.name: Full()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the full UUID data.

methods.name: operator== (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Equality comparison with another UUID.

methods.name: operator!= (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Inequality comparison with another UUID.

methods.name: operator== (const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if the UUID matches a given short UUID.

methods.name: operator!= (const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if the UUID does not match a given short UUID.

methods.name: operator< (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Less-than comparison for UUID ordering.

methods.name: HasShort()
methods.description: Checks if the UUID is a short UUID.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length indicator of the UUID (2 or 16).

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the UUID data bytes.

methods.name: ToString(const bool full = false)
methods.description: Converts the UUID to its string representation.

methods.name: FromString(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Parses a string to initialize the UUID.
